reason: This is where the Contentstack SDK Stack is initialized (line 69). The options object (lines 55-67) lacks the live_preview configuration required by the Contentstack JS SDK to enable real-time preview. Without live_preview: true in the Stack options, no preview connection is ever established, so no downstream provider or hook can receive live updates regardless of how they are wired.
fix: Add live_preview config to the options object before Stack initialization. The Contentstack JS SDK requires `live_preview: true` (and optionally `live_preview_host`) in the Stack options. Change the options object (lines 55-67) to include `live_preview: { enable: true, host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST }` where CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is a new env var (or omit host to use the default). Also add CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST to the destructured env vars at lines 17-24. The existing `options` export and `Stack` initialization pattern already support arbitrary SDK options — this is purely additive. After this, the ContentstackProvider (src/context/ContentstackContext.tsx) must also be updated to subscribe to Stack.livePreviewQuery and update its context state reactively (currently it uses useMemo with a static defaultContent), but the Stack init is the prerequisite cause — without it, no preview events flow at all.
